title: CVE-2026-90817 actively exploited: code injection in REDCap research data capture system
content_md:
CVE-2026-90817 is a critical, actively exploited flaw that allows code injection in REDCap, a Research Electronic Data Capture system. The source text cuts off after referring to one of its users.

Original article: https://infonewscyber.fr/info/cve-2026-90817-activement-exploitee-injection-de-code-dans-le-systeme-816726b4adb76dca

CVE-2026-90817.evidence: CISA added CVE-2026-90817 to KEV on November 18, 2026 based on evidence of active exploitation; the post itself also claims active exploitation.
